items.q: Right, distant cousin of mine, and I went with him because he was working with Erskine Tate at the Vendome Theater

ctx.x: Now, Buster in the book it says (unintelligible), he was a cousin of yours.
Right, distant cousin of mine, and I went with him because he was working with Erskine Tate at the Vendome Theater, and I used to go down there, and he would come over and take lessons.
Well, was Buster about the same age as you?
